subject: Future Tech
title: Radiation Shielding
description: Learn Radiation Shielding in one minute.

hook.text: Outside Earth's magnetic field, cosmic rays and solar storms bombard everything. Unshielded humans get lethal doses.

buildup.text: On the ISS, astronauts receive radiation equal to a chest X-ray every few days. A Mars trip would be far worse.

discovery.text: Water and hydrogen-rich plastics block cosmic rays effectively.

twist.text: Galactic cosmic rays are so energetic that no practical shield blocks them completely. Some exposure is unavoidable.

climax.text: Mars habitats may be buried under regolith. A few meters of soil provides enough shielding for a lifetime of living.

quiz.question: What material effectively blocks cosmic radiation in space habitats?
